title: Bound localized EUR field initializer text
changes: Bound the generated content of all five localized entry-zero strings used by a conditional field initializer.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-field-copy-dis-wine-wvq_b39w inspects the original 08019d98 expansion and termination grammar.
Wine e158-byte00-field-localized-screen-wine-dgzrlx3q authenticates the EUR ROM and checks the five pointer-table entries: none of the generated bytes through the terminator contains 40 67 01.
limitations: The fixed-size copy also includes bytes beyond the terminator, which may depend on previous buffer contents. Actual state transitions, saved and aliased bytes, other writers, callback invocation and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
